role: Unit tests for ObservationValidator covering all five validation checks and metrics.
detail: Test suite for ObservationValidator class covering five independent validation checks: (1) min area fraction (default 0.001), (2) min confidence (default 0.30), (3) embedding L2 norm bounds (0.1 to 100.0), (4) bbox aspect ratio bounds (0.1 to 10.0), (5) enabled=False bypass. Includes test classes: TestValidObservation (pass-through), TestDisabledValidation (bypass), TestAreaFractionCheck, TestConfidenceCheck, TestEmbeddingNormCheck, TestAspectRatioCheck, TestMultipleFailures (all checks reported at once), TestMetrics (counter accumulation). Helper _make_obs() builds minimal valid Observation with configurable bbox/confidence/embedding. Helper _unit_embedding(dims, norm) computes uniform vector with exact L2 norm. Tests use standard library math and pytest, cobeing imports only. ValidationConfig parameters tested: enabled, min_area_fraction, min_confidence. Metrics keys tested: observations_validated, observations_rejected, rejected_by_area, rejected_by_confidence, rejected_by_embedding_norm, rejected_by_aspect_ratio.
gotchas: No pytest plugins or advanced mocks; all test data constructed manually. Tests assume ValidationConfig defaults but parametrize them explicitly. Embedding norm edge cases: zero vector rejected, norm > 100 rejected, None embedding skips check. Aspect ratio computed as width/height (not inverted). Frame area = 1280*720 = 921600 used for area fraction threshold calculations.
